intro: The Call of Water is a spiritual quest for shamans ready to commune with the purifying nature of the water element. Having established harmony with wind, earth, and flame, the initiate reaches Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan, who urges them to take the first step toward learning water's purity.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Long has it been since ye were last tested, friend. Ye have shown patience thus far in yer studies, but the time has come for ye to learn about the purity of water.
Seek out Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan. He is along the north western edge o' the lake, south of Stonewrought Dam. Ye will find him there at his burrow hut. Good luck to ye, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The wind's rushin' at yer back, the stone's firm beneath yer boots, and the fire in yer belly's burnin' bright. Aye, it's time ye learned the truth o' water's purity. Yer path's been long, but it's yer spirit that'll carry ye further still. Now, go on, take that first step. The mountain waits for no one.
